title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Work with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and natural language processing to analyze product feedback. You will clean text data, build simple models, evaluate results, and present insights to the data science team.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Join a retail analytics team building recommendation models for customer behavior. Responsibilities include SQL analysis, Python notebooks, feature engineering, model evaluation, and dashboard summaries.

title: NLP Research Assistant
description: Support applied NLP research projects using TF-IDF, text classification, embeddings, and topic modeling. The role is ideal for students who enjoy machine learning experiments and reading research papers.

title: Business Analyst Intern
description: Prepare Excel reports, summarize business KPIs, and support stakeholder presentations. This role focuses on finance reporting, documentation, and manual data checks.

title: Backend Software Engineering Intern
description: Build Python APIs, write tests, and collaborate with engineers on backend services. Some exposure to data pipelines, SQL, and cloud deployment is helpful.

title: Marketing Operations Intern
description: Assist with social media calendars, campaign reporting, influencer research, and brand content planning. This position is best for candidates interested in digital marketing.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description: Analyze healthcare datasets using Python, SQL, and pandas. Create dashboards, clean messy data, and communicate insights about patient engagement and operations.

title: AI Product Intern
description: Work between product and machine learning teams to improve an AI education platform. Tasks include user research, evaluating model outputs, writing product notes, and tracking experiments.

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: Monitor alerts, review security tickets, document incident response steps, and learn about network security tools. Python scripting is a plus but not the main focus.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Help build ETL pipelines, validate datasets, write SQL transformations, and support analytics engineers. Experience with Python and clean code is preferred.
